description: List the Workday apps available on your home screen, each with a launchable task id. Use this to discover what you can read, then pass an app's `taskId` to `workday_get_task` to open it. Some apps share a generic launcher id; if one returns a near-empty page, open the app in your browser and pass that URL to `workday_get_task` instead. Read-only.
name: workday_get_apps
title: List your Workday apps
